summary: Iteration 77 — Phase 2/3/4 (Membership Entitlements checkout engine + wallet order-from-wallet + merchant builder) end-to-end verified against the shared FastAPI backend on BOTH web (design=radiolife) and mobile (Expo web preview). BACKEND: 10/10 pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/test_iter77_entitlement_checkout.py. (a) /api/shop/orders/quote applies option upcharges (Large+Cheese on mi_biz_sample_funpizza_0 → subtotal 2399); (b) with apply_entitlement_id=ent_free_pizza on the same line → entitlement_discount_cents 1799, total_cents 600, matches E1 spec exactly (line.entitlement_id + applied_entitlements returned); (c) validate_selection surface: applying ent_free_pizza to non-Pizza coffee item returns 400 code=entitlement_not_eligible; (d) GET /api/shop/businesses/biz_sample_funpizza/my-entitlements returns Pizza Club with max_upcharge_cents=1000, remaining≥0, eligible_items list containing all 4 sample pizzas; (e) GET /api/shop/memberships/mine benefit rows include both v2 keys (entitlement_id, remaining, used, period_key) AND legacy aliases (qty, period, options); (f) LEDGER: POST /api/shop/orders/checkout on a coffee w/ Unlimited Coffee → total_cents=0, free-checkout path settles order and used-count on the entitlement increments by exactly +1 after the checkout (idempotent, verified via re-fetching /memberships/mine); (g) REGRESSION: flat-price menu quote (no options, no entitlement) still returns correct subtotal — additive change confirmed non-breaking; (h) MERCHANT CRUD: POST /api/merchant/marketplace/memberships/items persists schema_version=2 plan with entitlement_id (ent_...), reset_frequency=weekly, stackable=true, max_upcharge_cents=500, category='Pizzas', day_time.days=[0,1,2]; POST /api/merchant/marketplace/menu/items persists option_groups with normalized group_id/option_id (grp_.../opt_...), size groups forced to max_select=1, multi groups keep max_select=3. WEB: Login via /api/auth/login cookie → shop menu /shop/menu/biz_sample_funpizza inside data-testid=rl-overlay shows all 4 pizzas with Membership tag; tapping Choose on Mac & Cheese Pizza opens data-testid=item-option-modal with Pizza Club AUTO-APPLIED (BASE FREE, Medium=Included, crossed-out $17.99, total $0.00) — E1's most-specific-entitlement auto-apply verified. Toggling 'Use Pizza Club' OFF restores total to $17.99. /shop/memberships (rl-my-memberships-page) shows Pizza Club with 'Order with this membership' row + all 4 pizza cards (benefit-order-ent_free_pizza-mi_biz_sample_funpizza_0..3). Merchant dashboard nav (rl-merchant-dash-page) exposes Memberships/Menu/Products entries. MOBILE (Expo): demo-login-btn → shop/menu/biz_sample_funpizza; item-option-sheet opens with Pizza Club auto-applied identically (BASE FREE, Medium Included, $0.00) — full web/mobile parity. /shop/my-memberships shows Pizza Club with mymem-order-row-ent_free_pizza + 4 mymem-order-* item cards. /merchant/memberships shows mmem-form builder with all v2 entitlement fields (target type any|category|item, qty, reset, max upgrade $, days Mon-Sun, start/end hr, stack w/ coupons, roll over). No critical bugs found. Deprecated packages: NONE (audit clean). React warnings observed (props spread w/ key) are pre-existing and non-blocking.
action_items: (Nice-to-have) Concurrent entitlement redemption race (called out in iter76 review) is still not gated — two simultaneous /orders/checkout calls consuming the same daily=1 entitlement would each write a consumed row. record_order_entitlements is idempotent PER (order_id, entitlement_id, item_id) so it protects against duplicate ledger rows for ONE order, but nothing protects across two concurrent orders. Consider a unique index on (membership_id, entitlement_id, period_key) with a $inc atomic guard, OR a MongoDB transaction on the redemption path.

(Nice-to-have) The Coffee Club Unlimited Coffee entitlement (qty=99 daily) is more 'huge' than 'unlimited' — the number in the UI drops each order. Consider quantity=999 or a distinct 'unlimited=true' flag with a bypass in entitlement_remaining so the wallet shows 'Unlimited' rather than '99 of 99 left this day'.

(Copy) Web modal shows Medium=Included ONLY when membership is applied and Medium=Free (delta 0) when it isn't. Both labels rendered by the RadioLife modal come out to $0 for the user, but 'Included' vs 'Free' is a subtle distinction only the eagle-eyed will spot — worth surfacing a tooltip once.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/marketplace_orders.py::_price_menu — Points-to-award still uses `after_entitlement` (post-entitlement amount) not `total`. Per E1's note this is intentional (points on the post-entitlement amount) but flag: it also runs points calc even when total==0 free checkouts. Recommend awarding 0 points on a $0 total or documenting the intent.

/app/backend/routes/marketplace_orders.py::_price_menu:172 — points_discount_cents subtracts, then total_cents can go to 0. That's fine, but line 155 raises HTTPException(400, 'zero_total') when SUBTOTAL <= 0. If a merchant ever prices an item at $0 (freebie), the whole basket 400s. Not exercised now but worth switching the check to `total_cents < 0` at the tail.

/app/backend/services/membership_entitlements.py::evaluate_line_entitlement applies to 'ONE unit of the line' — this is correct per spec, but if qty>1 the customer only gets ONE waived and pays full price for the rest. The engine returns discount_cents on ONE unit, and _price_menu:152 adds unit_price*qty for subtotal. The applied_entitlements row's base_value_cents captures the waived value of the one unit. Good — matches E1's spec that entitlement applies to ONE unit of the line. Confirm this is documented in customer-facing UI copy so nobody adds 3× a $17.99 pizza expecting 3× free.

/app/backend/routes/marketplace_memberships.py::claim_benefit still validates the legacy `choice_labels` (see iter76 review, unchanged). Not blocking Phase 3 since the checkout path uses option_id validation via validate_selection.
/app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/ItemOptionModal.jsx — 'Medium: Included' vs 'Medium: Free' rendering (see action items) is a copy nit, not a bug.

Sample plan mplan_sample_biz_sample_funpizza_pizza's Pizza Club entitlement has daily qty=1 → after ONE successful order, further /orders/quote with apply_entitlement_id=ent_free_pizza returns 400 code=entitlement_exhausted. No test executed a real checkout of the pizza (would burn the daily quota needed by manual QA); only the coffee free-checkout path was exercised end-to-end for ledger recording.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (web menu modal + wallet + merchant dashboard; mobile item sheet + my-memberships + merchant memberships builder)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Ledger collection = membership_redemption_ledger. Entitlement applies to ONE unit per line. Ent_free_pizza is daily qty=1, so after one successful pizza checkout the entitlement is exhausted until the next UTC day — plan around this when running full checkout flows. The free-checkout path (total_cents=0 after entitlement) is exercised for coffee. To exercise pizza's ent_exhausted path deterministically, first burn ent_free_pizza with a checkout, then re-quote and expect 400 code=entitlement_exhausted. All web tests must scope to [data-testid='rl-overlay'] to hit the visible shop instance. Cookie auth: page.evaluate fetch('/api/auth/login',{credentials:'include'}) then navigate. Mobile Expo preview: use demo-login-btn on landing, then navigate to /shop/menu/biz_sample_funpizza and /shop/my-memberships and /merchant/memberships.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Phase 2/3/4 are wired correctly per spec across the shared backend, web, and mobile.
